*   **Key Security:** Never expose your API key in public code repositories, frontend applications, or screenshots[3][4]. Use environment variables to store your key securely[3][4].

### 3. Hardware-Linked Promotions (3 to 12 Months Free)

*   **ASUS Partnership:** Purchasing eligible ASUS and ROG laptops includes a **3-month trial** of Google AI Pro or AI Plus, redeemable via the "MyASUS" portal app.
*   **Google Pixel & Partner Devices:** Buying select high-end smartphones like the Pixel 9 Pro, Pixel 9 Pro Fold, or select Samsung Galaxy flagships often includes a **1-year free trial** of the Google One AI Premium plan, usually activated via the Google One app during device setup.

### 4. Gemini API Free Tier (Google AI Studio)
If the goal is developer access to the underlying models rather than the consumer chat interface, Google provides a free tier via the API.
*   **How to get it:** Sign in to [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/), where you can generate an API key to access "free-capable" models (like the Flash family) without a credit card.
*   **Note:** This tier has rate limits, and data sent via the free tier may be used by Google to improve its models. Do not enable billing on your Google Cloud project if you want to remain strictly on the free tier.

### ⚠️ A Note on "Reddit Workarounds"
Discussions on Reddit frequently mention "hacks" such as using VPNs, temporary emails, or third-party fake ID generators to bypass student verification. 
*   **Risks:** These methods explicitly violate Google's Terms of Service and can result in account bans (losing access to Gmail, Drive, etc.). Third-party generators also pose significant phishing and malware risks. I recommend sticking to the official channels listed above.
